description: Modèle numérique de terrain haute résolution des zones inondables de la Loire et de ses affluents is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Délimitation des zones couvertes par un levé topographique haute résolution sur la Loire inondable et ses affluents. Le levé lidar haute résolution est un modèle altimétrique très précis des zones inondables de la Loire et partiellement de quelques affluents. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include levé lidar, L'Indre, MNT, GRID, Le Cher, semis de points. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
